synthetic_npz_encoding.setting_and_operation_schedule: array name binds CALIBRATION_CONTRACT.json and immutable generation receipt
synthetic_npz_encoding.timestamp: no physical timestamp; array index is explicitly synthetic
synthetic_npz_encoding.record_and_readout: one uint8 per trial; the eight code values encode f-/f+/pf-/pf+/ppf-/ppf+/ppp-/ppp+
synthetic_npz_encoding.between_trial_reset: fresh vacuum for every independent synthetic trial
synthetic_npz_encoding.leakage: zero by the selected synthetic source model; not an observed hardware exclusion

qualification_rule: A hardware source missing any field needed for the claimed metric/coverage is NOT_CERTIFIED; processed means may support only the specific processed observable that they preserve.
independence_rule: Fixed-sample Hoeffding coverage assumes independent stationary repetitions in each setting. Drift or dependent acquisition needs a separate valid concentration/coverage argument, not reuse of the iid radius.
